correctness.rationale: Conditional distribution of a uniform prefix and sorted suffix yields exact means/covariance via independent Lehmer inversion digits and internal uniform-permutation descent/inversion covariance. Conditional joint CLT follows from finite-population CLT, one-dependent descent triangular array, inversion Hájek projection, and asymptotically independent occupancy. The exact total covariance and McDiarmid fourth moments justify the scaled covariance limit beyond weak convergence. The self-contained checker passed 219 finite assertions, which corroborate but do not prove the infinite theorem.
